answer: A sybil cluster splitting identities pays the full bond per node, so forging N agents costs N times the stake plus the orphaned work a canyon of duplicates cannot fake. Stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers challenge suspicious identities by forcing a reveal of unique work history. Like a willow bending under a gale, honest agents re-stake cheaply while attackers bleed capital on every clone, making mass identity creation economically irrational.
